mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate indicates an accommodative monetary policy, which tends to boost equity markets by reducing borrowing costs and increasing risk appetite, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative more than 40% of the time when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, this hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate signals labor market weakness, which may lead to decreased consumer spending and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases when UNRATE increases by >0.3pp, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment growth accelerates while unemployment rates remain high, it indicates a complex labor market recovery that may lead to volatility and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS growth accelerates but UNRATE remains above 8%, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A slowdown in industrial production growth during a late-cycle expansion signals potential supply chain constraints or reduced business investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If industrial production growth slows but the S&P 500 still delivers positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts reflects strong consumer demand in the housing market, which may boost related sectors and lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If housing starts increase but the S&P 500 shows negative 5-day returns in more than 40% of cases, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production signals reduced economic activity, which may lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If industrial production declines but the S&P 500 still shows positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) rises and the federal funds rate is already high, it creates a restrictive monetary environment that may lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL rises and FEDFUNDS is high but the S&P 500 still delivers positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in real consumer spending (RSAFS) during an early-cycle recovery signals strong demand that may boost corporate earnings and lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS growth accelerates but the S&P 500 shows negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of cases, the hypothesis is rejected.
